caption: The drawing depicts a single clay pipe positioned horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The pipe has a rounded bowl with a slightly darker rim at the top and a cylindrical stem that tapers slightly toward the mouthpiece. The bowl of the pipe is a light tan or beige color, with brownish shading near the rim and some darker, irregular patches suggesting areas of discoloration or staining. There is a faint inscription on the bowl, which reads "Paul Blunden 1868." The stem has a similar light tan color with some bluish-green and brownish marks along its length, indicating wear or residue. Below the image of the pipe, on the right side of the drawing, is the name "LLOYD C. LEMCKE" printed in capital letters. The background is empty and shows slight speckling or faint marks, but no other objects are present in the drawing.
title: Pipe
